headline: BBC, Sky diverge on how close Guimaraes deal really is
paragraphs: The clearest transfer story around the six clubs concerns Arsenal and Newcastle's Bruno Guimaraes. BBC reported on July 31 that a fee had been agreed, but Sky's Sunday coverage described Newcastle as merely 'braced for' an Arsenal approach — the two accounts do not agree on how advanced this is. Sky also reported Everton have agreed a £7m fee for Arsenal's Norgaard and that Manchester United are considering a move for teenager Myles Lewis-Skelly, per Sunday's papers.

Real Madrid's pursuit of Manchester City's Rodri ran through BBC's gossip column for most of the past week: Madrid were reported 'confident' of a deal on July 24, Man City were described as bracing for a bid on July 28, and Madrid were again called 'confident' on July 29. No fee, medical or second outlet has been reported since, and BBC's coverage is the only source for the story in this feed.

Liverpool are reported by BBC to have verbally agreed a move for PSG's Bradley Barcola, though the two clubs remain apart on valuation after PSG set a £145m asking price on July 27 — no resolution has been reported since. Separately, BBC's Sunday gossip column linked Bayern Munich with Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko. Both remain single-source reports with no confirmation from either club.
